claim: Hierarchical context engineering provides the largest gains when reasoning depth is limited or when the candidate set cannot be exhaustively ranked by a single agent.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by comparing hierarchical and single-agent performance across tasks with varying reasoning depth and candidate set size.

conditions: Candidate set cannot be exhaustively ranked by a single agent
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the two chemical domains studied and the specific hierarchical architectures; transfer to other domains or architectures is unestablished.

title: Hierarchical context engineering–Search efficiency gain over boundary
